title: Score Decrements When Earning Points Above 500 Threshold
explanation: At frame 417, PlayerData.set_score dropped score from 500 to 490 (-10) after collecting a coin, triggering unexpected_score_change. Defect repeatedly manifested across window w02 at frames 613, 664, 702, and 763. Traced to PlayerData.gd:L33-L35 where gaining score when old_score >= 500 calculates final_score = old_score - 10, violating score monotonicity and core reward contracts.
